app.title: Vitrail Settings
surface.help: Solid only changes alpha. Glass adds blur and a light edge.
language.label: System language
language.help: Changes Vitrail and your next session.
palette.scheme.help: How the palette is derived from the wallpaper.
sound.outputApps: Show the apps in the volume card
sound.outputApps.help: One row per app playing audio, with its own volume and mute.
sound.inputApps: Show the apps in the microphone card
sound.inputApps.help: One row per app using the microphone.
sound.focusApps: Focus the app from its icon
sound.focusApps.help: Clicking an app's icon brings its window forward (applies to both lists).
fonts.system.help: Apps and the shell both use it; a new window picks it up at once.
fonts.console.help: The terminal's family; its size stays on the Terminal page.
fonts.preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
fonts.uiIcons.help: The Material Symbols family the bar and this window draw their icons from.
fonts.iconTheme.help: The icon theme GTK apps take their application icons from.
fonts.cursor.help: A pack already installed; palette-tinted cursors come with P2.10.
fonts.design.help: Recolours an installed pack with the wallpaper's palette and uses it as the cursor.
fonts.iconsTint.help: Recolours the folders of an installed pack with the wallpaper's palette.
fonts.spinner.help: The wait cursor becomes Vitrail's turning shape instead of the pack's.
windows.opacityHelp: Transparency is applied per window. 0% is fully opaque; blur only shows where there is transparency.
windows.borderHelp: The border marks focus and follows the radius above.
monitors.help: Each output keeps its own mode, scale, rotation and place. A monitor without a change follows Hyprland's defaults.
monitors.unavailable: Hyprland is not running: the saved layout will apply at the next session.
monitors.position.help: Auto lets Hyprland arrange it; off pins the exact position.
monitors.reset.help: Reset returns this monitor to Hyprland's defaults.
input.mouseHelp: Focus follows the pointer when it enters a window.
keyboard.help: Add every layout you use. Switch between them with the shortcut below.
bar.help: Docked melts the bar into the frame. Corners only keeps the rounded screen corners without a border.
design.scale: Titles, subtitles and body text scale from this base size.
design.share: Share a style with: vitrail style export --out my-style.json
layout.help: niri-style columns: windows flow sideways and the strip scrolls. Turn it off for classic tiling.
plugins.help: Plugins are QML folders in ~/.local/share/vitrail/plugins. They run inside Vitrail, so only install code you trust.
terminal.help: Applied to kitty on every change: the tab bar re-reads its settings and running terminals reload their config.
wallpaper.fit.help: Inside the frame, the wallpaper makes room when a full panel opens. Whole screen never moves.
wallpaper.empty: No wallpapers of this kind yet: use Add to bring some in. Vitrail keeps its own copies.
bar.panelPush: Windows make room for full panels (whole-screen wallpaper)
network.title: Network
bar.osd.keys: Show the OSD with the media keys
bar.osd.keys.help: The volume and brightness keys show their slider for a moment.
wallpaper.kindHelp.image: Photos and pictures: their colors theme the whole system.
wallpaper.kindHelp.svg: Adaptive art: {{primary}}-style placeholders take the palette in light and dark.
wallpaper.kindHelp.video: Animated wallpapers: one frame lends its colors.
wallpaper.order.help: With several wallpapers selected, they take turns.
bar.capture.recordRegion: Record a region instead of the screen
dialog.auth.title: Authentication required
wallpaper.sequence.help: Drag the pictures to change their turn. Used when rotating in order.
wallpaper.sequence.random: Shuffle ignores this order; it only counts when rotating in order.
wallpaper.systemColor.help: The color of the whole system: apps, bar and terminal take their palette from it, and adaptive SVGs are tinted with it. Automatic follows the wallpaper.
tooltip.powerHint: Click: menu · Right click: quick menu
datetime.help: Click a point on the map, zoom with the wheel and drag to move, or search below. Applying asks for your password.
datetime.ntp.help: Keeps the clock in sync over the network. Changing it asks for your password.
language.system.help: Makes it the system language too. Asks for your password and applies after you log out and back in.
keyboard.numlock.help: Turns Num Lock on when the session starts.
launcher.empty.calc: Type a calculation or conversion: 2^10, 5 km in miles, 10 usd to eur
launcher.empty.files: Type part of a file name
launcher.runHint: Enter: in a terminal · Shift+Enter: detached
launcher.bangs.help: Type !key and your text to search that site
launcher.bang.name: Name
launcher.bang.url: Address, with %s where the search goes
launcher.history.help: Forget which apps you launch most. Favourites and hidden apps stay.
launcher.hidden.help: Brings back every app hidden from the launcher.
tooltip.launcherHint: Click / Super: full screen · Right click: compact
osd.brightnessAccess: Brightness needs access to the monitors' i2c bus. Run the installer, then log out and back in.
osd.brightnessMissing: Install ddcutil to control the brightness of external monitors.
notifications.title: Notifications
clipboard.hint: Enter copies · Shift+Enter copies only · Ctrl+Enter without the newline
powerprofile.saver.detail: Slower clocks and a dimmer screen: the battery lasts longer.
powerprofile.balanced.detail: Speed when it is needed, less power when it is not.
powerprofile.performance.detail: Full speed: more heat and more battery used.
connection.wifi.help: Joins open networks and the ones you already saved.
connection.vpn.mode.help: Split sends only the URLs below through the VPN; Full sends everything. The mode is global: it applies to whichever connection is up.
connection.bluetooth.scan.help: Looks for devices nearby for a few seconds.
connection.vpn.failed: The last VPN request failed (%1). The vitrail-settings journal has the details.
connection.vpn.startup.help: Mirrors vitrail-vpn's marker: on while a tunnel is up. Turning it on connects the best connection, turning it off disconnects. Connecting or disconnecting anywhere else changes it too.
connection.vpn.urls.help: In split mode only these sites go through the VPN. Adding a URL also adds the live subdomains that certificate transparency lists for its domain.
connection.vpn.url.invalid: Enter an http(s) URL or a host name
connection.vpn.url.refresh.help: Looks every URL up again and re-applies its addresses.
connection.vpn.credentials.help: A name with a user name and a password, shared by any number of connections. Passwords stay in vitrail-vpn's private vault and are never shown.
connection.vpn.credential.name: Name
connection.vpn.credential.newPassword.he: Leave empty to keep the current one
connection.vpn.credential.duplicate: A credential with this name exists
connection.vpn.credential.removeConfirm: Remove %1? Connections that use it stay, without a credential.
connection.vpn.credential.noFolder: No private folder for passwords ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is not set): credentials cannot be added or changed.
connection.vpn.import.help: Choose an OpenVPN file. Vitrail keeps its own copy in a folder only you can read; vitrail-vpn generates its split-tunnel config from it.
connection.vpn.import.name: Name (optional)
connection.vpn.import.invalid: Enter the full path of a .ovpn or .conf file
connection.vpn.import.move.help: Delete it once the copy in Vitrail's private folder is verified.
connection.vpn.conn.name: Name
connection.vpn.conn.credential.help: The credential this connection signs in with.
connection.vpn.conn.noCredentials: There are no credentials yet. Add one in the VPN settings.
connection.vpn.conn.auto.help: Whether connecting at startup may pick this connection as the best one.
connection.vpn.conn.removeConfirm: Remove %1? Its config file and vault entry are deleted.
downloads.body.busy: The app kept writing after the file was removed; cancel again or close it.
bar.notifications.snooze.help: 15 minutes, 1 hour or tomorrow, and it comes back by itself.
bar.notifications.muted.help: Comma-separated: they are listed, never toasted.
bar.notifications.urgent.help: Comma-separated: their cards are marked and may bypass Do Not Disturb.
bar.notifications.urgentBypass: Urgent notifications bypass Do Not Disturb
bar.notifications.urgentBypass.help: Off: urgent only marks the card.
session.confirm.problem.help: This action would interrupt it. Cancel the action or go ahead anyway.
tooltip.notificationsHint: Left click: the centre · right click: silence for an hour
tooltip.notificationsCount: %1 in the centre · right click: silence for an hour
tooltip.notificationsMuted: Silenced · right click to turn them back on
